contentPattern.structure: author photo + name (h2) + role + social links

suitableFor: article author/contributor bio cards with a small circular photo, name, role and social links
compact person cards (profile + a few links) at the end of editorial content
notSuitableFor: grey two-column featured-article teasers with a large image and CTA (use wknd-featured-teaser)
general side-by-side content columns (use vanilla columns / columns-article)
repeating people/team card grids (use a cards variant)
